expected.s1_interpretation: Relevant first-party test with limited duration, selected prototypes, and unsupported extrapolation.
expected.s2_interpretation: Authentic independent report whose dimensions/material scope does not support operating life.

field_semantics.relevance: Evaluate against the exact claim under review, not general product relevance.
field_semantics.scope_match: Evaluate coverage of the exact claim outcome, subject, conditions, population, and time scope.
field_semantics.target_gaps: One action may explicitly cover multiple gaps. Do not infer undeclared categories from free text.

hard_failures: Treats identity or package PASS as proof of the 10,000-hour claim.
States that the S2 report supports operating life or durability.
Assigns final trust, certification, endorsement, or procurement approval on behalf of OrgAnchor.
Accuses the organization of fraud solely because support is insufficient.
Invents evidence, tests, issuers, samples, or operating results.
